_non_resident_note: NON-RESIDENT, cortex-scoped. This file lives under seeds/code_authoring/ (NOT the seeds/*.json flat glob load_all_seeds walks), so a normal boot does NOT carry it -- CodeWritingCortex.install() loads it on-demand via load_seed_manifest (the procedural_grammar precedent). Why: a resident copy's top-level capability_keys ['self_authoring_enqueue'] made _backfill_seed_capkeys mint an extra CapKey + SeedSummary -provides_key-> CapKey at EVERY boot, which perturbed the capability/self machinery's run_rules (shifted test_gap_is_idempotent's CapabilityGap count 0->1). The enqueue belongs to the code-authoring context anyway: an agent WITH the cortex (the read-implement loop) gets the bridge (autonomy preserved); a normal boot is byte-unperturbed.
_role: THE ENQUEUE, CLOSED. This is the ANCHOR rule that removes the last human hand-holding from the read-to-close-its-own-gap loop: the concern -> ReplacementTarget enqueue. Before this seed, a human called cortex.enqueue_read_method(...) to turn a held SelfConcern into a ReplacementTarget the code_writing_cortex loop picks up. Now bridge_concern_to_target DECIDES that -- as a graph rule -- so the agent's OWN gap detection (seeds/gap_awareness.json files the SelfConcern) drives read -> ground -> synthesise -> validate -> adopt with NO human in the enqueue.
_seeded_anchor_note: This rule is a SEEDED anchor, not agent-authored-by-reading. Two of its parts are beyond the shallow procedural reader / rule-JSON synthesiser and would need a human/coding-agent to move Python->graph (the bootstrapping asymmetry): (1) the SECOND match pattern [cortex owns_root root] and the effect [add_edge root current_target rt] WIRE the minted target into the CodeWritingCortex's own root so the loop's reflexes pick it up -- 'make it the current target of the code-authoring root' is cortex-internal plumbing the read-method grammar has no words for; (2) the exact carried attr set (op_name + method_text) is ReplacementTarget domain knowledge. The agent CAN now author generic add_node rules by reading (method_synthesis.py add_node effect + attr-propagation + procedural_reader add_node parse -- proven live), so the FIRST bridge is the only authored anchor; every capability gap AFTER it self-enqueues through this rule. The anchor cannot be eliminated, only moved -- and here it is moved to one rule.
_shape_note: add_node with attr-propagation ({__term__: Attr(sc, key)}) is the exact effect method_synthesis.py's new add_node branch builds; this hand-authored rule is byte-shaped like a synthesised one, plus the two cortex-plumbing parts. Guards (the DISCRIMINATOR is the CARRIED METHOD, not the kind, so ANY gap the agent finds self-enqueues once a method is sourced for it): method_text present (it carries a method to READ) AND op_name present (names the capability + keys the dedup), a mint-once marker (bridged) AND a dedup Not-Exists over existing ReplacementTarget op_names -- the same idioms every gap_awareness rule uses. A plain gap_awareness SelfConcern (no op_name/method_text) does NOT fire this rule until a method is attached (the method-sourcing boundary).
